theme.style: A dark, technical control-room aesthetic built for basketball data: deep charcoal and near-black courts of color punctuated by electric orange and cool steel-blue highlights, evoking scoreboard glow and hardwood under stadium lights. Surfaces feel like brushed carbon fiber and frosted glass, with crisp analytical lighting and subtle grid textures suggesting precision and live stats. Bold but controlled, engineered for legibility and speed rather than decoration.
